title: ✨ You don’t need to be famous to make an impact.
paragraphs:
✨ You don’t need to be famous to make an impact.
Sometimes, all Heaven needs is someone willing to be faithful enough to be useful.
Let your purpose speak louder than popularity. 🌤️
Colossians 3 : 23 — “Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters.”
